prompt: A curious Shiba Inu slowly leans forward to inspect the glowing iPhone on the floor, camera slowly pushes in from medium shot to extreme macro. Audio: soft ambient room tone, whisker rustle, faint mechanical click when nose touches the screen.

Slow-motion shot of amber whiskey being poured into a crystal glass on a dark walnut bar, condensation catching amber tungsten light. Audio: liquid pouring, ice clinking, muffled jazz in the background.
A rain-slick Tokyo alley at night, one figure with an umbrella walks toward the camera, neon signs reflecting on wet asphalt. Audio: soft rain, distant traffic hum, footsteps on wet ground.
A paper boat floats down a garden stream, cherry-blossom petals drifting in the water, dappled sunlight through leaves. Audio: gentle stream, birds chirping, wind rustling leaves.
A ballerina in a red tutu executes a slow-motion grand jeté in an empty theater, dust motes catching a single spotlight. Audio: soft slippers on wood, distant orchestral cue.
A meadow at dusk, hundreds of fireflies rise from tall grass as a light breeze passes through. Audio: crickets, soft wind, no music.

First light in a small Parisian bakery: a baker opens the shutters, dust motes float in the light, a tray of croissants steams in the foreground. Audio: shutter rolling up, crinkling paper, kettle whistling.
A robotic quadruped patrols a neon-lit rooftop, its head servos tracking a distant object, wind whipping trailing cables. Audio: precise servo motors, distant helicopter, wind.
An arctic fox pounces through fresh powder, snow puffing around its paws, mid-morning sun casting long shadows. Audio: paws crunching snow, sharp exhale, wind over ice.
Two astronauts float in a lunar research lab, gently rotating a holographic globe of Mars between them, blue console glow. Audio: HVAC hum, muted comms chatter, plastic gloves against a rail.
